service.name: model-runtime
service.concurrency: serialized by an in-process inference lock

model.name: Qwen3.5-4B
model.model_loading: offline local files only; first valid request loads the base model and adapter

input_contract.image_path_policy: The image must be inside MODEL_RUNTIME_IMAGE_ROOT, MODEL_RUNTIME_UPLOAD_ROOT, or the model/training datasets root; the service rejects paths outside those roots.
input_contract.text_policy: Case text may be accepted by the local service payload but is not used in the image classification prompt and is not sent to external APIs by this contract.

output_contract.empty_confidence_policy: A zero or empty confidence is allowed by the runtime but must be treated as unusable for automation or triage.
output_contract.truncated_policy: When truncated=true, the response is incomplete and must not be treated as a valid model conclusion.

environment.MODEL_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN: optional; when set, X-Internal-Service-Token must match
environment.MODEL_RUNTIME_UPLOAD_ROOT: required for business image uploads; must point to the shared upload directory
environment.HF_HUB_OFFLINE: forced to 1 when the service loads the local model

failure_behavior.invalid_path_or_image: 403 or 422; no GPU load for invalid requests
failure_behavior.backend_policy: The business analysis pipeline treats Qwen as optional; failure or timeout is recorded as skipped/degraded and must not block case review.

notes: The runtime reads local image paths and performs local GPU inference.
The business backend remains responsible for keeping case text and image content away from external model and search providers.

acceptance_checks: GET /health returns ready when the base model and adapter files are present.
GET /v1/models lists qwen_judgment, adapter, and disabled decision roles without loading the GPU.
POST /v1/judge returns compact JSON with the frozen adapter SHA256 and requires_human_review=true.
Invalid image paths are rejected before GPU loading.
The backend degrades or skips Qwen when the runtime is unavailable or slow.
The backend does not send case text or image content to external summary or search APIs.
known_limitations: This contract defines runtime behavior and resource evidence, not model accuracy or clinical validity.
The runtime is research-use-only and must not be used for autonomous or unsupervised care.
The current candidate was evaluated on a same-source grouped OCT test set, not a patient-isolated external validation set.
Confidence calibration, subgroup performance, camera robustness, and prospective clinical safety remain unknown.
